title: 20-20-20 Rule
instruction: Look at an object at least 20 feet away for 20 seconds to relax your eye muscles.

title: Blink Slowly
instruction: Close your eyes gently, pause for 2 seconds, then open slowly. Repeat 4 times.

title: Eye Circles
instruction: Roll your eyes slowly in a circle clockwise, then switch to counter-clockwise.

title: Palming
instruction: Rub your hands together to warm your palms, then gently cup them over your closed eyes.

title: Near & Far Focus
instruction: Hold your thumb 10 inches from your face. Focus on it for 5 seconds, then focus on a distant point.

title: Shoulder Rolls
instruction: Roll your shoulders backward slowly 5 times, then forward 5 times to release tension.

title: Neck Stretch
instruction: Gently tilt your head toward your shoulder and hold for 10 seconds. Switch sides.

title: Stand and Walk
instruction: Stand up, stretch your arms overhead, and walk around your room or office.
